correctness.rationale: The primary source supplies the complete ten facet normals for h >= 2 and proves very ampleness. The independent symbolic computation verifies all ten vertex/facet incidences by polynomial inequalities, all 18 two-cones, exactly two primitive cross-product indices equal to four, unimodularity at the other six fixed points, and rank-three torsionfree ray lattices at four nonsimplicial endpoints. Toric smoothness and orbit closures then give precisely two singular P1s. Two saturated basis identities reduce each transverse cone to rays (1,0),(1,4), whose dual semigroup k[U,V,W]/(UV-W^4) proves the A_3 model. Two primitive source-polytope edges give projective line degrees one. Finite hull checks are merely corroborative; the all-h proof uses symbolic formulas.

Full singular support, two line degrees, generic A_3 germs, exact failure-of-Q-factoriality points and class group ranks comprise a substantive complete classification.
